text.p: Juventus of Italy beat Ajax of the Netherlands 4-1 in their European Cup semifinal second leg on Wednesday.
Juventus - Attilio Lombardo 34, Christian Vieri 36, Nicola Amoruso 79, Zinedine Zidane 81

Juventus: 1-Angelo Peruzzi; 2-Ciro Ferrara, 20-Alessio Tacchinardi, 4-Paolo Montero, 13-Mark Iuliano, 14-Didier Deschamps, 19-Attilio Lombardo, 7-Angelo Di Livio, 21-Zinedine Zidane (8-Antonio Conte 85), 9-Alen Boksic, 15-Christian Vieri (16-Nicola Amoruso 69).

Ajax: 1-Edwin Van der Sar, 4-Frank De Boer, 3-Danny Blind, 29-Mario Melchiot, 8-Richard Witschge (17-Marino Juan 85), 5-Winston Bogarde, 19-Arnold Scholten (18-Kiki Musampa 57), 10-Jari Litmanen, 11-Marc Overmars, 7-Tijani Babangida, 6-Ronald de Boer.
